scripts.db:reset:remote: wrangler d1 execute djuniors-db --remote --file=schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute djuniors-db --remote --file=seed.sql
scripts.dashboard:build:prod: cd dashboard && VITE_API_BASE=https://api.djuniors.id npm run build
scripts.pages:deploy:admin: cd dashboard && npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=djuniors-admin
scripts.deploy:all: npm run dashboard:build && wrangler deploy && npm run pages:deploy
scripts.deploy:all:admin: npm run deploy:all && npm run pages:deploy:admin
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run pages:deploy && npm run pages:deploy:admin
